prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE new standalone high-fidelity iOS screen for Minor AI in the established ASSISTANT-FIRST / FOCUS concept. Portrait 2:1 height-to-width, same as the supplied editor screen reference, approximately 887x1774. One complete front-facing iPhone mockup, slim titanium bezel, small even margins, no perspective or external captions. This is a real-looking mobile product concept, not a website or a marketing poster. Image references set the precise product family: retain dark #121212, restrained #232323 surfaces, white primary actions, mint #2FFF9E only for selected/active, map branches mint #5EF0B0 sky #7CC4FF lilac #C9A2FF pink #FC86C3 sun #FFD66B coral #FC9886. Clean SF Pro-like type, Russian UI, body 16-17pt, native 44pt touch targets, 24pt content margins, 16-20pt corner radii, fine low-contrast borders. Status bar 9:41 and Dynamic Island, clear bottom safe area. Keep meaning and hierarchy, avoid tiny text, fake widgets, card-in-card clutter, gradients everywhere, robots, brains, lens flares and new brand marks. The sample project is 'Запуск подкаста'. No payment prompts, prices, ratings, badges or user counts. Do not replicate the reference as-is: render the specific new interaction state below. All text spelled accurately. Main app continues to welcome user as an AI assistant; no project-dashboard homepage or four-tab bottom bar.
STATE: THE ASSISTANT HAS JUST CREATED A MIND MAP DURING A NORMAL CONVERSATION. Reference 1 supplies chat chrome; reference 2 supplies map node visual style. Header menu on left, centered 'Minor AI', discreet model menu right. Beneath header quiet conversation title 'Запуск подкаста'. No central empty-state logo or greeting now that there are messages. A single user message, right aligned in subtle mint-tinted surface: 'Хочу запустить подкаст о дизайне. Помоги составить план.' Assistant reply left-aligned directly on background, not another massive bubble: 'Начнём с идеи, аудитории и первого выпуска. Я собрал основу карты.' Below, one genuinely useful result card takes central third of screen: title 'Запуск подкаста', subtitle 'Карта готова', a clearly drawn miniature map with central white root 'Подкаст' and five readable colored branches 'Идея', 'Аудитория', 'Формат', 'Запись', 'Продвижение'. Inside bottom of this result card one wide white button 'Открыть карту'. Under card one quiet text action 'Сделать слайды из карты' with small arrow, no extra carousel or chips. Bottom fixed composer 'Спросите Minor' with plus, microphone and circular white send control. Use comfortably generous but not huge gaps; no keyboard. Emphasize assistant conversation naturally producing a usable map.
